paragraphs: Rabbi Beroka Choza’ah—Elijah would often be with him—was standing in the market of Bei Lefet. Elijah came; a prison guard passed there, wearing black shoes and without tzitzit, and also two jesters. Elijah told him: “These three are destined for the world to come” (Taanit 22a). In chapter Hanose: Beroka; Rashi explains: the name of a sage.
